summary: Orion Digital Corp. (formerly Mogo Inc.) filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for May 2026, attaching a notice of its Annual General Meeting. The meeting is scheduled for June 23, 2026, with a record date for notice and voting of May 11, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance filing by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a proxy statement or meeting notice in the US. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign is referenced. The only action is a standard annual shareholder meeting, not a forced CEO departure or structural transaction.
